title: SysDVR Overlay
description: Control and inspect SysDVR from an overlay.
author: ppkantorski
details:
SysDVR Overlay is an Ultrahand overlay for checking and changing the current SysDVR streaming mode directly from the overlay menu.

It provides quick access to SysDVR controls without opening the standalone SysDVR configuration application and is intended to be used alongside an installed SysDVR sysmodule.
